# wellbeing_survey_answers (Data Source)

Aggregated survey answers for the company.

Selected-option answers are grouped: one entry per option, carrying a `count` and a null `time`. Free-text answers always have `count` 1 and carry the answer `time`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `department_id` (String) Restrict results to one department.
- `period` (String) Reporting period. `YYYY-Q1` through `YYYY-Q4` for quarterly surveys, otherwise `YYYY-M`.
- `survey_id` (String) Restrict results to one survey.

### Read-Only

- `answers` (Attributes List) Matching answers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--answers))

<a id="nestedatt--answers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `answers`

Read-Only:

- `answer` (String)
- `count` (Number)
- `period` (String)
- `question_key` (String)
- `survey_id` (Number)
- `time` (String)
